name: bash-lsp
description: Bash/Shell Language Server for Claude Code

hooks.command: case "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_AUTO_INSTALL:-true}" in false|0|no|off) ;; *) [ -x "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}/node_modules/.bin/bash-language-server" ] && diff -q "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/package.json" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}/package.json" >/dev/null 2>&1 || (cd "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}" && cp "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/package.json" . && npm install --loglevel=error) || rm -f "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}/package.json" ;; esac

auto_install.title: Auto-install language server
auto_install.description: Install and update the language server in the plugin data directory at session start. Turn off to skip it; the server then runs whatever is already installed there.
